subject: MITTENS
name: Mittens (orange tabby beside a curly-haired man)

styleSelection.reason: Watercolour portrait sketch: light value washes carry the cat's patches and the face planes; fine pen lines carry eyes, whiskers and contours; paper stays white around both heads.

MIT.human-hair.reason: Curls are below four cells as separate locks: one blue-grey value mass with paper flecks, a darker glaze on the shadow side, directional pen curls by value.

MIT.human-hair-side.reason: Same curly mass running down behind the ear: grey wash, shadow glaze, a few curl lines.

families.referenceCue: Orange tabby head looking up: cream and white ground, burnt-sienna patches on the brow and cheek, white muzzle with fine whiskers, pale green eyes with dark rims.
Cat chest mostly white paper; raw and burnt sienna stripes down the left edge and in the fur behind the man's cheek, laid as a few broken strokes.
Dark curly hair: blue-grey wash with soft wet edges into paper, darkest under the curls and over the forehead line, white flecks between curls.
Hair falling behind the right ear, grey with broken edge into white paper.
Light warm skin: forehead and cheeks almost paper, warm sepia shadow down the left cheek against the cat, brows and lids in brown, stubble a broken pale tone round the mouth.
